01 / The person behind the platforms

Deep in the code.
Clear on the
bigger picture.

I’m Braj—an engineering leader, software architect, and hands-on builder. Since 2007, I’ve worked across cross-border payments, remittance, mobility, commerce, enterprise platforms, and data systems.

As Head of Engineering at Nairagram, I connect engineering strategy with the realities of moving money: partner APIs, payout reliability, compliance workflows, reconciliation, production operations, and the people who keep it all working.

I’m comfortable in the architecture discussion and in the code that follows. My work brings together product thinking, technical depth, team leadership, and operational accountability.

03 / How I can help

The right depth.
Where it matters.

For founders building a product, fintech teams strengthening a platform, and businesses that need experienced engineering ownership.

01

Fintech & payment architecture

+

From customer pay-in to payout, settlement, and reconciliation. I design the transaction states, integration boundaries, and operational controls that make the full lifecycle understandable.

  • Cross-border remittance, wallets, FX, and partner integrations
  • Payout orchestration, callbacks, retries, and failure recovery
  • Double-entry ledger design and reconciliation workflows
02

Engineering leadership

+

Hands-on leadership for businesses that need clear technical direction and a team that can deliver it. I work across architecture, hiring, mentoring, planning, code quality, and production ownership.

  • Technical roadmaps and delivery governance
  • Code review, quality practices, and engineering mentorship
  • Alignment with founders, product, finance, and operations
03

Full-stack product development

+

Build and improve customer applications, administrative platforms, B2B portals, and API products, with the backend and business workflows treated as first-class parts of the experience.

  • PHP/Laravel, Python, Node.js, and React applications
  • Mobile backend APIs and real-time communication
  • Commerce, ERP, institute management, and data platforms
04

Cloud, security & modernization

+

Practical work on the software and infrastructure that already runs your business: performance bottlenecks, safer releases, clearer monitoring, and maintainable upgrade paths.

  • MySQL optimization, caching, queues, and system performance
  • Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, and incident response
  • API security, access control, code review, and legacy upgrades
05

AI, forecasting & data systems

+

Use data and AI where they improve operational decisions. My experience includes payment forecasting, analytics, fraud signals, and assisted workflows with clear controls.

  • Prophet, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Python data pipelines
  • BigQuery reporting and operational dashboards
  • AI-assisted interfaces and workflow automation
06

Vetted remote engineering talent

+

For businesses that need more delivery capacity, I can help connect them with vetted remote developers and guide technical fit.

  • Zero recruitment fee; clients pay talent directly
  • Role and stack alignment before introductions
  • Optional technical leadership and delivery oversight
